name: fixes-2041
notes: Consolidated check of the four fixes from the 15-year campaign (user, 2026-10-23): a year from that campaign's final save (2041, campaign year ~15.6), strategist on. Run: tools/run.ps1 -Probe fixes-2041 -SavePath lab/results/20261022-232243-campaign-2026-15y/final.gz, with tools/strategist.ps1 -Harness. Expect: the terminus begins by date in the first month; no new capital hulls while the exotics stock is at or below the war chest in deficit; dry ships split off (Victor-27 at Aspasia); fleets on send orders join strikes; strategist strike lists of at most five.
asserts: sum(e['invest'] for e in events('terminus', ev='month')) > 0
all(len(e['directives'].get('AlienCouncil', {}).get('strikeTargets') or []) <= 5 for e in events('strategist', ev='applied'))
info: [(e['t'], e['ev'], e.get('why'), round(e.get('after', 0), 3), round(e.get('invest', 0), 1)) for e in events('terminus')][::3]
[(e['t'][:7], e['stock']['Exotics'], e.get('warChest'), round(e['drip'], 1), e['upkeep'], e['shipUpkeep'], e.get('slack'), e.get('largeFactor')) for e in events('economy')]
[(e['t'], e['fleet'], e['at'], e['ships'], e['dry'], e['dvBefore'], e['dvAfter'], e.get('goal')) for e in events('dry-split')]
[(e['t'][:7], e['targetSystem'], round(e['need']), round(e['have']), [(d['fleet'], round(d['scv']), d.get('was')) for d in e['donors']]) for e in events('pool') if e['donors']]
sum(1 for e in events('pool') for d in e['donors'] if d.get('was') == 'SendFleet')
[(e['t'][:7], e['targetSystem'], round(e['have']), round(e['need'])) for e in events('pool-muster')]
[(r['t'][:7], r['fleet'], round(r['scv']), r['toSystem'], r.get('targetFaction')) for r in events('transfer', goal='AttackWithFleet') if r['scv'] > 1000]
(count('combat', attacker='AlienCouncil', occurred=True), count('combat', attacker='AlienCouncil', occurred=True, winner='AlienCouncil'))

[(e['t'], e['directives'].get('AlienCouncil', {}).get('posture'), e['directives'].get('AlienCouncil', {}).get('strikeTargets'), (e['directives'].get('AlienCouncil', {}).get('intent') or '')[:220]) for e in events('strategist', ev='applied')]

{f: (round(faction(first, f).get('scv', 0)), round(faction(last, f).get('scv', 0))) for f in ['DestroyCouncil', 'CooperateCouncil', 'ExploitCouncil', 'EscapeCouncil', 'SubmitCouncil', 'AppeaseCouncil']}
